reason: The cited lines show the tool parses arguments, calls repository.searchRepositories(query, page, perPage), and returns the JSON-serialized results. They do not show any arbitrary host code execution. They also do not show delivery to an agent-chosen or attacker-readable destination; at most a query is passed to a repository search helper. The lines alone do not establish whether the search uses credentials or can return non-public/private repository data, so SECRET is insufficient. The returned repository search results are external repository metadata/content that can be controlled by repository owners, so UNTRUSTED is supported.
